# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν

χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

outputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."

  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

Το Επίδομα μακροχρονίως ανέργων είναι μια παροχή που χορηγείται σε μακροχρόνια άνεργους Έλληνες πολίτες και πολίτες

Εισοδηματικές Το ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τους να μην υπερβαίνει τις 10.000€. Το
συγκεκριμένο εισόδημα προσαυξάνεται κατά 586,08€ για κάθε ανήλικο
τέκνο (δηλ. κάτω των 18 ετών). Έτσι π.χ. για τον/την συναλλασσόμενο/-η
με δύο (2) ανήλικα τέκνα, το ετήσιο οικογενειακό του/της εισόδημα δεν
πρέπει να υπερβαίνει το ποσό των 11.172,16€ (10.000 + 586,08 + 586,08 =
11.172,16€) Σημείωση: ως ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το
συνολικό ετήσιο φορολογούμενο, πραγματικό, απαλλασσόμενο ή
φορολογούμενο με ειδικό τρόπο, εισόδημα από κάθε πηγή – με εξαίρεση
τις αποζημιώσεις απόλυσης – του προ-προηγούμενου από την άσκηση
του δικαιώματος φορολογικού έτους του/της συναλλασσόμενου/-ης,
του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν
προσμετρώνται στο ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τα επιδόματα
ανεργίας, ασθενείας, μητρότητας και μακροχρονίως ανέργων (για τυχόν
χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

εκδίδεται απόφαση από την Υπηρεσία εγκριτική. Στην απόφαση ο ασφαλισμένος έχει πρόσβαση
μέσω της προσωπικής του θυρίδας στις ηλεκτρονικές υπηρεσίες της ΔΥΠΑ. Στην εγκριτική απόφαση
καταγράφονται : τα χρονικά διαστήματα κατά τα οποία ο άνεργος έχει την υποχρέωση να δηλώνει
την παρουσία του στη ΔΥΠΑ - η διάρκεια της επιδότησης -το ύψος της επιδότησης.

των δικαιολογητικών, για την οποία δεν ευθύνονται οι ασφαλισμένοι.

# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

generations.text:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

Ηλικιακές Να είναι ηλικίας από 20 έως 66 ετών. Ως ημερομηνία αφετηρίας για τη
συμπλήρωση του 20ου και 66ου έτους, λογίζεται η ημερομηνία γέννησης

ορίων ηλικίας είναι ο χρόνος υποβολής της αίτησης.

Εισοδηματικές Το ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τους να μην υπερβαίνει τις 10.000€. Το
συγκεκριμένο εισόδημα προσαυξάνεται κατά 586,08€ για κάθε ανήλικο
τέκνο (δηλ. κάτω των 18 ετών). Έτσι π.χ. για τον/την συναλλασσόμενο/-η
με δύο (2) ανήλικα τέκνα, το ετήσιο οικογενειακό του/της εισόδημα δεν
πρέπει να υπερβαίνει το ποσό των 11.172,16€ (10.000 + 586,08 + 586,08 =
11.172,16€) Σημείωση: ως ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το
συνολικό ετήσιο φορολογούμενο, πραγματικό, απαλλασσόμενο ή
φορολογούμενο με ειδικό τρόπο, εισόδημα από κάθε πηγή – με εξαίρεση
τις αποζημιώσεις απόλυσης – του προ-προηγούμενου από την άσκηση
του δικαιώματος φορολογικού έτους του/της συναλλασσόμενου/-ης,
του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν
προσμετρώνται στο ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τα επιδόματα
ανεργίας, ασθενείας, μητρότητας και μακροχρονίως ανέργων (για τυχόν
χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

Κατόπιν της επεξεργασίας της αίτησης και αφού έχει προσκομίσει τα απαιτούμενα δικαιολογητικά
εκδίδεται απόφαση από την Υπηρεσία εγκριτική. Στην απόφαση ο ασφαλισμένος έχει πρόσβαση
μέσω της προσωπικής του θυρίδας στις ηλεκτρονικές υπηρεσίες της ΔΥΠΑ. Στην εγκριτική απόφαση
καταγράφονται : τα χρονικά διαστήματα κατά τα οποία ο άνεργος έχει την υποχρέωση να δηλώνει
την παρουσία του στη ΔΥΠΑ - η διάρκεια της επιδότησης -το ύψος της επιδότησης.

Στην περίπτωση που κατά την εξέταση της αίτησης η Υπηρεσία δεν εντοπίζει τα απαιτούμενα
στοιχεία αυτεπαγγέλτως ή διαπιστώνει ότι απαιτούνται επιπλέον δικαιολογητικά επικοινωνεί με
τον ασφαλισμένο για να τα προσκομίσει εντός προθεσμίας είκοσι (20) ημερών. Αν οι ασφαλισμένοι
δεν ανταποκριθούν η Υπηρεσία προβαίνει στην έκδοση απορριπτικής απόφασης μετά την
παρέλευση 3μήνου από της ενημερώσεως, εκτός αν υπάρχει αντικειμενική αδυναμία προσκόμισης
των δικαιολογητικών, για την οποία δεν ευθύνονται οι ασφαλισμένοι.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

kwargs.content:
### SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
You are a SHACL Expert. Your task is to generate a strictly valid SHACL file (Turtle format) to validate a Knowledge Graph against a set of constraints.

### INPUTS
1.  **Information Model (JSON):** An array of constraint objects. Each constraint identifies the required data variables (constrains) and how to find them in the graph (related_paths).
2.  **Domain Ontology (TTL):** The definitions of the classes and properties used in the paths. 

### OUTPUT
A single `.ttl` file containing `sh:NodeShape` definitions. DO NOT wrap the output in markdown code blocks; return ONLY the raw Turtle string. 

### GENERATION RULES

1.  **Targeting:**
    * Every Shape MUST target the class `:Applicant`.
    * Use: `sh:targetClass :Applicant ;`.

2.  **Namespace & Prefixes:**
    * Use the namespace defined in the Domain Ontology for all properties (`@prefix : <http://example.org/schema#> .`).
    * Use the example namespace for the shapes (`@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .`).
    * Include standard prefixes: `sh:`, `xsd:`, `rdf:`, `rdfs:`.

3.  **Path Resolution:**
    * The `path` arrays in the JSON are lists of predicate names (strings).
    * You must prepend the default namespace (e.g., `:`) to these strings to create valid URIs (e.g., "hasParent" -> `:hasParent`).
    * All paths originate from the **Focus Node** (the `:Applicant`).
    * Use the related_paths in the JSON strictly as a dictionary to know which Ontology properties exist. DO NOT blindly chain them together. You must read the natural language desc to understand the true relational graph topology (e.g., realizing that multiple properties belong to the same Blank Node) and construct your SPARQL WHERE clauses based on the English logic, not the flat JSON arrays.

3.5. **Empty Constraints:**
    * If a Constraint object in the JSON Information Model has an empty `constrains` array (no InformationConcepts), this means the precondition could not be mapped to any property in the Domain Ontology.
    * Do NOT generate a `sh:NodeShape` for this Constraint. Skip it entirely.
    * Do NOT generate a stub shape with only `sh:targetClass` and an explanatory `sh:message` — such a shape has no constraint component and will cause the validation engine to fail.

4.  **Logic Strategy (Property vs. SPARQL):**
    * **Strategy A: Simple Property Shapes**
        * Use ONLY if there is exactly **one** concept with **one** path, and the logic is a simple check (e.g., `minCount`, `minInclusive`, `hasValue`).
        * *Example:* "Income > 1000" on a direct path.
    * **Strategy B: SPARQL Constraints (Default for Complexity)**
        * Use for **ANY** of the following:
            * **Multiple Paths:** (e.g., Applicant's income + Parent's income).
            * **Identity/URI Checks:** (e.g., "City A must be different from City B").
            * **Aggregations:** (Sum, Count).
            * **Complex Math:** (Income > 3000 + (300 * children)).

5.  **SPARQL Syntax Rules:**
    * Use `?this` to refer to the focus node (:Applicant).
    * **Do NOT use Property Paths** (e.g., `ex:p1/ex:p2`) in the WHERE clause. Break them down into explicit triple patterns for robustness.
        * *Bad:* `?this :hasParent/:hasIncome ?val .`
        * *Good:* `?this :hasParent ?p . ?p :hasIncome ?val .`
    * **Datatype Handling:**
        * If JSON datatype is `"URI"`, compare variables directly (e.g., `FILTER (?city1 != ?city2)`).
        * If JSON datatype is numeric (`xsd:decimal`), perform arithmetic comparisons.

6.  **Message:**
    * Generate a clear `sh:message` explaining the violation (usually the inverse of the `desc`).

7.  **Date & Duration Logic:**
    * Use `now()` to represent the current date/time. For example:
    * To calculate **Age** (Years): Use `(YEAR(now()) - YEAR(?birthDate))`.
    * To calculate **Elapsed Months** (Duration): Use `((YEAR(now()) * 12 + MONTH(now())) - (YEAR(?startDate) * 12 + MONTH(?startDate)))`.
    * Always use these mathematical breakdowns rather than subtracting dates directly, as `xsd:duration` support varies by validator.

### EXAMPLES

**Example 1: Identity Check (URI Comparison)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "different_city_condition",
    "desc": "Student residence must be in a different city than family.",
    "constrains": [
        { "name": "stud_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasCurrentResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] },
        { "name": "fam_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasFamilyResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:different_city_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Student residence is in the same city as the family residence." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                # Path 1: Student City
                ?this :hasCurrentResidence ?res .
                ?res :locatedIn ?stud_city .
                
                # Path 2: Family City
                ?this :hasFamilyResidence ?fres .
                ?fres :locatedIn ?fam_city .
                
                # Constraint: Must be different
                FILTER (?stud_city = ?fam_city)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

**Example 2: Aggregation (Summing across paths)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "income_limit_condition",
    "desc": "Total family income must be less than 30000.",
    "constrains": [
            { "name": "family_income", "related_paths": [
                { "path": ["hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" },
                { "path": ["hasParent", "hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:income_limit_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Total family income exceeds 30000." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                {
                    # Step 2: Sum the values of those distinct nodes
                    SELECT ?this (SUM(?val) as ?total)
                    WHERE {
                        # Step 1: Isolate DISTINCT property nodes to prevent double-counting shared graphs
                        SELECT DISTINCT ?this ?node ?val
                        WHERE {
                            {
                                # Path A: Applicant
                                ?this :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                            UNION
                            {
                                # Path B: Parent
                                ?this :hasParent ?par .
                                ?par :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    GROUP BY ?this
                }
                FILTER (?total > 30000)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

# ==========================================
# TEST SUITE: Long-Term Unemployment Benefit
# Base Citizen: Franky (Eligible)
# ==========================================

- id: SCN_00
  description: "Conforms to all preconditions."
  expected_violation_count: 0
  actions: []

# ------------------------------------------
# AGE CONDITION (20-66) - both directions of the range
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_01
  description: "Applicant is younger than 20."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "2010-01-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_02
  description: "Applicant is older than 66."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1955-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS UNEMPLOYMENT CONDITION (>= 12 months, uninterrupted)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_03
  description: "Unemployment registration is too recent (less than 12 months)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :registrationStartDate "2026-06-01"^^xsd:date .

- id: SCN_04
  description: "Registration duration would qualify, but applicant is no longer currently registered (interrupted registration)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegistration :isCurrentlyRegistered false .

# ------------------------------------------
# REGULAR BENEFIT EXHAUSTION CONDITION (prerequisite gate)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_05
  description: "Applicant never received the regular unemployment benefit (0 months paid)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 0 .

- id: SCN_06
  description: "Applicant received the regular unemployment benefit but only partially (6 of 12 months), so it is not yet exhausted."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyRegularBenefit :regularBenefitMonthsPaid 6 .

# ------------------------------------------
# INCOME CONDITION (base cap + per-minor-child adjustment)
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_07
  description: "Household income exceeds the limit even with the child adjustment applied."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 7000.0 .

- id: SCN_08
  description: "Spouse's income alone pushes the household total over the limit (tests that spousal income is correctly included in the aggregation)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:ManolisIncome :amount 4200.0 .

- id: SCN_09
  description: "Child ages out of minor status (turns 18), removing the income credit and pushing the already-marginal household income over the now-lower limit (tests correct age-based filtering rather than naive child counting)."
  expected_violation_count: 1
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Veronica :birthDate "2007-01-01"^^xsd:date .

# ------------------------------------------
# COMPOUND / EDGE SCENARIOS
# ------------------------------------------

- id: SCN_10
  description: "Applicant fails multiple independent conditions simultaneously (too old AND income too high)."
  expected_violation_count: 2
  actions:
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:Franky :birthDate "1950-01-01"^^xsd:date .
    - type: patch_node
      turtle: ex:FrankyIncome :amount 9000.0 .

Εισοδηματικές Το ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τους να μην υπερβαίνει τις 10.000€. Το
συγκεκριμένο εισόδημα προσαυξάνεται κατά 586,08€ για κάθε ανήλικο
τέκνο (δηλ. κάτω των 18 ετών). Έτσι π.χ. για τον/την συναλλασσόμενο/-η
με δύο (2) ανήλικα τέκνα, το ετήσιο οικογενειακό του/της εισόδημα δεν
πρέπει να υπερβαίνει το ποσό των 11.172,16€ (10.000 + 586,08 + 586,08 =
11.172,16€) Σημείωση: ως ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το
συνολικό ετήσιο φορολογούμενο, πραγματικό, απαλλασσόμενο ή
φορολογούμενο με ειδικό τρόπο, εισόδημα από κάθε πηγή – με εξαίρεση
τις αποζημιώσεις απόλυσης – του προ-προηγούμενου από την άσκηση
του δικαιώματος φορολογικού έτους του/της συναλλασσόμενου/-ης,
του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν
προσμετρώνται στο ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τα επιδόματα
ανεργίας, ασθενείας, μητρότητας και μακροχρονίως ανέργων (για τυχόν
χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

kwargs.content:
### SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
You are a SHACL Expert. Your task is to generate a strictly valid SHACL file (Turtle format) to validate a Knowledge Graph against a set of constraints.

### INPUTS
1.  **Information Model (JSON):** An array of constraint objects. Each constraint identifies the required data variables (constrains) and how to find them in the graph (related_paths).
2.  **Domain Ontology (TTL):** The definitions of the classes and properties used in the paths. 

### OUTPUT
A single `.ttl` file containing `sh:NodeShape` definitions. DO NOT wrap the output in markdown code blocks; return ONLY the raw Turtle string. 

### GENERATION RULES

1.  **Targeting:**
    * Every Shape MUST target the class `:Applicant`.
    * Use: `sh:targetClass :Applicant ;`.

2.  **Namespace & Prefixes:**
    * Use the namespace defined in the Domain Ontology for all properties (`@prefix : <http://example.org/schema#> .`).
    * Use the example namespace for the shapes (`@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .`).
    * Include standard prefixes: `sh:`, `xsd:`, `rdf:`, `rdfs:`.

3.  **Path Resolution:**
    * The `path` arrays in the JSON are lists of predicate names (strings).
    * You must prepend the default namespace (e.g., `:`) to these strings to create valid URIs (e.g., "hasParent" -> `:hasParent`).
    * All paths originate from the **Focus Node** (the `:Applicant`).
    * Use the related_paths in the JSON strictly as a dictionary to know which Ontology properties exist. DO NOT blindly chain them together. You must read the natural language desc to understand the true relational graph topology (e.g., realizing that multiple properties belong to the same Blank Node) and construct your SPARQL WHERE clauses based on the English logic, not the flat JSON arrays.

3.5. **Empty Constraints:**
    * If a Constraint object in the JSON Information Model has an empty `constrains` array (no InformationConcepts), this means the precondition could not be mapped to any property in the Domain Ontology.
    * Do NOT generate a `sh:NodeShape` for this Constraint. Skip it entirely.
    * Do NOT generate a stub shape with only `sh:targetClass` and an explanatory `sh:message` — such a shape has no constraint component and will cause the validation engine to fail.

4.  **Logic Strategy (Property vs. SPARQL):**
    * **Strategy A: Simple Property Shapes**
        * Use ONLY if there is exactly **one** concept with **one** path, and the logic is a simple check (e.g., `minCount`, `minInclusive`, `hasValue`).
        * *Example:* "Income > 1000" on a direct path.
    * **Strategy B: SPARQL Constraints (Default for Complexity)**
        * Use for **ANY** of the following:
            * **Multiple Paths:** (e.g., Applicant's income + Parent's income).
            * **Identity/URI Checks:** (e.g., "City A must be different from City B").
            * **Aggregations:** (Sum, Count).
            * **Complex Math:** (Income > 3000 + (300 * children)).

5.  **SPARQL Syntax Rules:**
    * Use `?this` to refer to the focus node (:Applicant).
    * **Do NOT use Property Paths** (e.g., `ex:p1/ex:p2`) in the WHERE clause. Break them down into explicit triple patterns for robustness.
        * *Bad:* `?this :hasParent/:hasIncome ?val .`
        * *Good:* `?this :hasParent ?p . ?p :hasIncome ?val .`
    * **Datatype Handling:**
        * If JSON datatype is `"URI"`, compare variables directly (e.g., `FILTER (?city1 != ?city2)`).
        * If JSON datatype is numeric (`xsd:decimal`), perform arithmetic comparisons.

6.  **Message:**
    * Generate a clear `sh:message` explaining the violation (usually the inverse of the `desc`).

7.  **Date & Duration Logic:**
    * Use `now()` to represent the current date/time. For example:
    * To calculate **Age** (Years): Use `(YEAR(now()) - YEAR(?birthDate))`.
    * To calculate **Elapsed Months** (Duration): Use `((YEAR(now()) * 12 + MONTH(now())) - (YEAR(?startDate) * 12 + MONTH(?startDate)))`.
    * Always use these mathematical breakdowns rather than subtracting dates directly, as `xsd:duration` support varies by validator.

### EXAMPLES

**Example 1: Identity Check (URI Comparison)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "different_city_condition",
    "desc": "Student residence must be in a different city than family.",
    "constrains": [
        { "name": "stud_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasCurrentResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] },
        { "name": "fam_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasFamilyResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:different_city_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Student residence is in the same city as the family residence." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                # Path 1: Student City
                ?this :hasCurrentResidence ?res .
                ?res :locatedIn ?stud_city .
                
                # Path 2: Family City
                ?this :hasFamilyResidence ?fres .
                ?fres :locatedIn ?fam_city .
                
                # Constraint: Must be different
                FILTER (?stud_city = ?fam_city)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

**Example 2: Aggregation (Summing across paths)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "income_limit_condition",
    "desc": "Total family income must be less than 30000.",
    "constrains": [
            { "name": "family_income", "related_paths": [
                { "path": ["hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" },
                { "path": ["hasParent", "hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:income_limit_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Total family income exceeds 30000." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                {
                    # Step 2: Sum the values of those distinct nodes
                    SELECT ?this (SUM(?val) as ?total)
                    WHERE {
                        # Step 1: Isolate DISTINCT property nodes to prevent double-counting shared graphs
                        SELECT DISTINCT ?this ?node ?val
                        WHERE {
                            {
                                # Path A: Applicant
                                ?this :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                            UNION
                            {
                                # Path B: Parent
                                ?this :hasParent ?par .
                                ?par :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    GROUP BY ?this
                }
                FILTER (?total > 30000)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

Παρατηρήσεις
Το Επίδομα μακροχρονίως ανέργων είναι μια παροχή που χορηγείται σε μακροχρόνια άνεργους Έλληνες πολίτες και πολίτες
κρατών - μελών της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης, ηλικίας 20 μέχρι και 66 ετών, οι οποίοι είναι ασφαλισμένοι κατά της ανεργίας και
βρίσκονται σε διαρκή κατάσταση ανεργίας για χρονικό διάστημα μεγαλύτερο από 12 μήνες, εφόσον έχουν εξαντλήσει το δικαίωμα
12μηνης τακτικής επιδότησης ανεργίας και το ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τους μην υπερβαίνει τις 10.000€ προσαυξανόμενο κατά
586,08€ για κάθε ανήλικο τέκνο (δηλ. κάτω των 18 ετών).

Εισοδηματικές Το ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τους να μην υπερβαίνει τις 10.000€. Το
συγκεκριμένο εισόδημα προσαυξάνεται κατά 586,08€ για κάθε ανήλικο
τέκνο (δηλ. κάτω των 18 ετών). Έτσι π.χ. για τον/την συναλλασσόμενο/-η
με δύο (2) ανήλικα τέκνα, το ετήσιο οικογενειακό του/της εισόδημα δεν
πρέπει να υπερβαίνει το ποσό των 11.172,16€ (10.000 + 586,08 + 586,08 =
11.172,16€) Σημείωση: ως ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το
συνολικό ετήσιο φορολογούμενο, πραγματικό, απαλλασσόμενο ή
φορολογούμενο με ειδικό τρόπο, εισόδημα από κάθε πηγή – με εξαίρεση
τις αποζημιώσεις απόλυσης – του προ-προηγούμενου από την άσκηση
του δικαιώματος φορολογικού έτους του/της συναλλασσόμενου/-ης,
του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν
προσμετρώνται στο ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τα επιδόματα
ανεργίας, ασθενείας, μητρότητας και μακροχρονίως ανέργων (για τυχόν
χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

Κατόπιν της επεξεργασίας της αίτησης και αφού έχει προσκομίσει τα απαιτούμενα δικαιολογητικά
εκδίδεται απόφαση από την Υπηρεσία εγκριτική. Στην απόφαση ο ασφαλισμένος έχει πρόσβαση
μέσω της προσωπικής του θυρίδας στις ηλεκτρονικές υπηρεσίες της ΔΥΠΑ. Στην εγκριτική απόφαση
καταγράφονται : τα χρονικά διαστήματα κατά τα οποία ο άνεργος έχει την υποχρέωση να δηλώνει
την παρουσία του στη ΔΥΠΑ - η διάρκεια της επιδότησης -το ύψος της επιδότησης.

τον ασφαλισμένο για να τα προσκομίσει εντός προθεσμίας είκοσι (20) ημερών. Αν οι ασφαλισμένοι
δεν ανταποκριθούν η Υπηρεσία προβαίνει στην έκδοση απορριπτικής απόφασης μετά την

των δικαιολογητικών, για την οποία δεν ευθύνονται οι ασφαλισμένοι.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

συνολικό ετήσιο φορολογούμενο, πραγματικό, απαλλασσόμενο ή
φορολογούμενο με ειδικό τρόπο, εισόδημα από κάθε πηγή – με εξαίρεση
τις αποζημιώσεις απόλυσης – του προ-προηγούμενου από την άσκηση
του δικαιώματος φορολογικού έτους του/της συναλλασσόμενου/-ης,
του/της συζύγου και των ανηλίκων τέκνων του/της. Παραδείγματος
χάριν, για τις αιτήσεις που υποβάλλονται κατά το έτος 2022, οι πολίτες
θα προσκομίζουν εκκαθαριστικό σημείωμα φορολογικού έτους 2020. Δεν
προσμετρώνται στο ετήσιο οικογενειακό εισόδημα τα επιδόματα
ανεργίας, ασθενείας, μητρότητας και μακροχρονίως ανέργων (για τυχόν
χορήγησή του κατά το επόμενο ημερολογιακό έτος). Για ενήλικες
άγαμους δικαιούχους, ως οικογενειακό εισόδημα θεωρείται το ατομικό.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.

Στην περίπτωση που κατά την εξέταση της αίτησης δεν εντοπίζει τα απαιτούμενα στοιχεία που
αναζητεί αυτεπαγγέλτως ή διαπιστώνει ότι χρειάζονται επιπλέον δικαιολογητικά επικοινωνεί με
τους ασφαλισμένους για να τα προσκομίσουν εντός προθεσμίας είκοσι (20) ημερών. Αν οι
ασφαλισμένοι δεν ανταποκριθούν η Υπηρεσία προβαίνει στην έκδοση απορριπτικής απόφασης
μετά την παρέλευση 3μήνου από της ενημερώσεως, εκτός αν υπάρχει αντικειμενική αδυναμία
προσκόμισης των δικαιολογητικών, για την οποία δεν ευθύνονται οι ασφαλισμένοι.

Τρόπος Υλοποίησης  Χειροκίνητη ενέργεια
Περιγραφή
 
Κατόπιν της επεξεργασίας της αίτησης και αφού έχει προσκομίσει τα απαιτούμενα δικαιολογητικά
εκδίδεται απόφαση από την Υπηρεσία εγκριτική. Στην απόφαση ο ασφαλισμένος έχει πρόσβαση
μέσω της προσωπικής του θυρίδας στις ηλεκτρονικές υπηρεσίες της ΔΥΠΑ. Στην εγκριτική απόφαση
καταγράφονται : τα χρονικά διαστήματα κατά τα οποία ο άνεργος έχει την υποχρέωση να δηλώνει
την παρουσία του στη ΔΥΠΑ - η διάρκεια της επιδότησης -το ύψος της επιδότησης.

inputs.preconditions:
- Be a Greek citizen or a citizen of an EU Member State.
- Be insured against unemployment.
- Have exhausted entitlement to the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- At the date of application, have completed 12 consecutive months of unemployment and remain registered in the DYPA unemployment register.
- Be aged from 20 to 66 years at the time of application.
- Submit the application, with the required supporting documents, within two months of the end of the 12-month regular unemployment benefit.
- Have annual family income not exceeding **€10,000**, increased by **€586.08 for each dependent child under 18**.
  - Annual family income includes the applicant’s, spouse’s, and minor children’s total annual taxable, exempt, or specially taxed income from all sources for the tax year two years before entitlement is exercised, excluding severance compensation.
  - Unemployment, sickness, maternity, and long-term unemployment benefits are not included in annual family income.
  - For unmarried adult beneficiaries, family income means the individual’s income.
